title: Curated list without the project sites: past landings and one representative Artemis III point, 24 months
description: Site records of the data stream (data/sites/curated_sites.json): past landing sites at the lander positions measured on LROC images, and one representative point of an Artemis III candidate region. Real terrain from every installed elevation product, without the 5 m near field; SPICE ephemeris. The requirements are the team's examples, not requirements of NASA or of any mission. No uncertainty is stated for these sites.
